name: Easy pickup
description: Write JAX get_observation(state) and compute_reward(state, action, next_state) for picking up the blue pyramid in a 9 x 9 XLand-MiniGrid room; LIMEN's evaluator trains PPO on them and scores the mean success rate within 80 steps over three 1M-step training seeds, or a 500K-step cascade run's rate if below 5 % (higher is better).

sources.locator: limen/evaluator.py (CascadeEvaluator), limen/train.py (PPO), limen/adapters/xminigrid.py, configs/easy_pickup.yaml, rulesets/easy_pickup.py and examples/evolved_interfaces/easy_pickup.py (MIT); run unchanged by the evaluator
XLand-MiniGrid 0.9.3 (Apache-2.0): environments, goal checks and rules; byte-identical to the PyPI wheel xminigrid==0.9.3

requirements.hardware: See upstream requirements and task notes.

evaluation.paper_metric: mean success rate across three seeds

notes: Paper task identified; evaluator invocation not yet verified.

limitations: Execution interface inspected in pinned source. Full paper experiments have not been reproduced here.
